solutions.title: Split, reverse, and join words
solutions.strategy: Use language word splitting to discard extra spaces, reverse the resulting list, and join with one space.

timeComplexity.explanation: The string is scanned to split words and scanned again to build the output.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The list of words and output string can together grow with the input length.

solutions.title: Scan words from right to left
solutions.strategy: Walk the string from right to left, extracting each word and appending it to the answer in discovered order.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character is skipped or copied a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output and collected words require space proportional to the input length.
